patch_description: Add a gradient-based annealing stage that maximizes a smooth soft-min/soft-max surrogate of the ratio using exponentially-weighted distance aggregation. A soft-min (log-sum-exp of -d/tau) and soft-max (log-sum-exp of +d/tau) give differentiable lower/upper bounds on dmin/dmax, so gradient ascent on their ratio smoothly approaches the true discrete metric as tau shrinks. A tau schedule annealing down to 0.002 and 0.001 (with exp arguments clipped to ±50 for numerical safety) sharpens the surrogate before the existing force-relax and SLSQP polish, letting the hill-climb start from a better basin. This directly implements the recommendation of extending the annealing floor below 0.005 with clipped exponentials, and it complements (rather than replaces) the existing discrete stages.
